summary: Require automatic recovery after external-state retry and gossip queue expiry
details: Extend independent multi-miner acceptance beyond the production two-minute downloader wait budget and, in Weekly, the thirty-minute fetcher queue lifetime without shortening runtime limits.

Require actual session exhaustion and a subsequent automatic downloader session; separately expire a single missing gossip tip whose parent is already local, so a larger downloader backlog cannot hide a lost recovery trigger.
Require recovery to a frozen existing canonical tip without mining, chain restart or manual reconnection, and preserve dependency readiness, local head and peer evidence if recovery times out.
Retain selector retry, peer continuity, bad-block, historical state-root and reward checks. Give Weekly a separate forty-five-minute simulation budget after compilation.
